context: Small change in resolve_backend + command entry: distinguish explicit local (silent) from implicit default fallback (loud/fatal), add backend-identity line, cover with unit tests, document in the tracker spec.
description:
2026-07-21 adversarial UAT review finding (P2, tracker integrity): resolve_backend (_project/scripts/todo_db.py:308-324) silently falls back to <main-root>/.todo-db/todo.sqlite when none of --db / TODO_DB_PATH / TODO_DB_URL is set. During the review this fallback answered `todo stats` with 1 active item while the hosted production DB has 32 active items - and a review subagent acted on the wrong picture. Local sessions without remote-env creds (the normal case per todo-db hosted ops: TODO_DB_URL/TODO_DB_AUTH_TOKEN live only in the cloud env) get a confidently wrong tracker view with zero indication.

Guard: on the IMPLICIT default-path fallback, either exit 2 with a pointer to the hosted-access pattern, or emit an unmistakable stderr banner (e.g. 'LOCAL FALLBACK DB - NOT the production tracker') on every command; print backend kind on all commands (local path vs 'hosted' - never the DSN). Explicit --db and TODO_DB_PATH pins stay silent: they are the supported test seam.

Decide fail-vs-warn deliberately: `init` and fresh-clone bootstrap must keep working, and CI jobs that pin TODO_DB_PATH must be unaffected.

anti_patterns.dont: auto-redirect to the hosted DB when creds happen to be findable
anti_patterns.instead: keep precedence; just make the fallback visible
anti_patterns.why: resolve_backend's precedence is deliberate (TODO_DB_PATH outranks TODO_DB_URL); magic redirection is the failure mode it prevents

anti_patterns.dont: make explicit TODO_DB_PATH pins warn or fail
anti_patterns.instead: guard only the implicit default-path fallback
anti_patterns.why: tests and CI legitimately pin local files; noise there trains people to ignore the banner

anti_patterns.dont: print the DSN, URL, or token in the banner
anti_patterns.instead: print backend kind, plus the filesystem path only for local backends
anti_patterns.why: the CLI contract explicitly never echoes its DSN; hosted creds are secrets

deferrals.reason: The recorded seq2 command selects _project/scripts, whose dependency manifest lacks pytest and BenchBox test dependencies; root-uv equivalent passes. Fix command authoring/runner validation generically rather than adding test-only dependencies to the production scripts environment.
deferrals.summary: Make todo verification commands self-contained across uv project boundaries

preserves.behavior: Explicit --db PATH and TODO_DB_PATH behavior byte-identical (tests and tools pin local files deliberately).
Hosted-mode behavior and the never-echo-DSN contract unchanged.
The G6 weekly export job (read-only token) keeps working unchanged.

prior_art.concept: export made truly read-only for the G6 job - the read/write command split this guard can reuse
resolve_backend precedence (--db > TODO_DB_PATH > TODO_DB_URL > default local) with documented rationale

verifications.expected: nonzero exit or unmistakable LOCAL-FALLBACK stderr banner; behavior with TODO_DB_URL set is unchanged

verifications.command: uv run --project _project/scripts -- python -m pytest tests/unit/scripts -k 'fallback or backend' -q

work_units.evidence: Decision recorded in _project/specs/todo-db-tracker.md: implicit reads warn and remain available; implicit writes fail before connect; init and true dry-runs remain available; explicit local pins are warning-free; every invocation reports backend kind without hosted DSN/token.
work_units.summary: Decide fail-vs-banner for implicit fallback (consider: reads banner + exit 0, writes exit 2 unless explicitly pinned); record rationale in the spec

work_units.evidence: Implemented backend-origin resolution, stderr backend identity, implicit-local read warning/write refusal with init and dry-run exceptions, plus authorized recursive trailing-slash scope matching and exit-status verification semantics. Ruff clean; focused fallback/backend/scope tests pass.
work_units.summary: Implement in resolve_backend/dispatch; backend-identity line on every command (kind only, never DSN/token)

work_units.evidence: Ruff check/format clean; implicit fallback command exits 0 with backend identity plus LOCAL FALLBACK banner; root uv test run over test_todo_db.py/test_todo_db_v2.py/test_todo_db_hosted.py/test_todo_wrapper.py: 162 passed. Recorded seq2 command was also run and fails before collection because the isolated _project/scripts manifest has no pytest; equivalent root-uv selection passes and the command-environment defect is promoted as a follow-up.
work_units.summary: Unit tests: implicit fallback loud, explicit --db/TODO_DB_PATH silent, hosted unchanged; update _project/specs/todo-db-tracker.md
